# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 0.1.0 - 2026-11-10

- First version: HubSpot remote MCP server over streamable HTTP.
- Added the 12 agent skills published in `HubSpot/hubspot-mcp-plugins` (commit `032d294b`), copied unchanged, with the original Apache-2.0 licence in `skills/LICENSE`.
- Added the 2 agents (`account-research`, `brief-fetcher`) from the HubSpot Sales plugin in the same repository and commit, copied unchanged.
